input: Get a professional financial plan consultation

gold.taskTitle: Get a professional financial plan consultation
gold.taskDescription: The user wants to schedule and attend a consultation with a professional financial planner or advisor.

questions.title: What is your primary financial goal for this consultation?
questions.description: Understand the core motivation — retirement, debt management, investing, buying a home, etc.

questions.title: Do you have a specific type of advisor in mind?
questions.description: Clarify whether the user wants a CFP, wealth manager, robo-advisor, bank advisor, or is open to any type.

questions.title: What is your budget for the consultation fee?
questions.description: Determine how much the user is willing to pay — free, flat fee, hourly rate, or percentage-based.

questions.title: Do you prefer an in-person or virtual meeting format?
questions.description: Find out if location or remote access is a factor in choosing an advisor.

questions.title: Have you worked with a financial advisor before?
questions.description: Gauge the user's familiarity and experience with financial consultations to tailor the approach.

questions.title: What is your target timeframe to have this consultation done?
questions.description: Establish urgency — is this needed within days, weeks, or by a specific life event or deadline?

questions.title: What financial documents or information can you currently provide?
questions.description: Identify what the user has ready — income statements, tax returns, debts, assets — to prepare for the consultation.
